name: aurora-3
description: Aurora 3.0, an Astro-based evolution of the Aurora theme.

scripts.build: astro check && astro build && pagefind --site dist
scripts.demo:build: ASTRO_SITE=https://yanpuzhen.github.io ASTRO_BASE=/astro-theme-aurora/demo/ ASTRO_DEMO_BUILD=true PUBLIC_AURORA_DIA=true pnpm build
scripts.test:preflight: pnpm test:preflight:config && pnpm test:preflight:comments && pnpm test:preflight:feeds
scripts.test:browser:preflight: ASTRO_PREFLIGHT_TESTS=true ASTRO_CONFIG_FILE=tests/fixtures/config-ui.yml pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_PATH=/config-smoke ASTRO_CONFIG_FILE=tests/fixtures/config-ui.yml playwright test tests/browser/preflight.spec.ts
scripts.test:browser:giscus: ASTRO_CONFIG_FILE=tests/fixtures/config-giscus.yml pnpm build && PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_PATH=/giscus-smoke ASTRO_CONFIG_FILE=tests/fixtures/config-giscus.yml playwright test tests/browser/giscus.spec.ts
scripts.test: node scripts/verify-build.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/verify-rc.mjs && pnpm test:preflight
